pages.text: Akaishi Crystals, the "sweat money" from ore clusters, are the source of everything in akaishi tech.$(br)9 crystals → a rough akaishi block, then into the Purifier → akaishi essence. From picking stones to building a fortune, it all runs on this line.

Akaishi Essence is the refined stuff, and you can keep squeezing it:$(li)9 essence → concentrated essence$(li)9 concentrated essence → concentrated essence block$(li)smelt the block → akaishi ingot$(br2)Remember this upgrade chain — it's how your wallet gets fat.
